title: Rav Huna bar Levai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in [Berakhot 55b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.55b.3) according to the [Ein Yaakov](https://www.sefaria.org/Ein_Yaakov_(Glick_Edition)%2C_Berakhot.9.5) reading; the Gemara has Rav Huna without further designation.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli gives Rav Huna without a patronymic in a statement about dreams. The Glick Ein Yaakov parallel likewise gives Rav Huna alone. It names Rabbi Levi in a separate statement immediately before his. The fuller form reported by Hyman is not confirmed by this edition, and the notice does not quote enough to fix his exact occurrence.
